title: Audit pictures show the window the way a person sees it in front, accent colours included
goal: The pictures in an audit are how the user judges what the loop built, but walks keep the app behind other apps, so every picture shows the inactive look: switches grey instead of green or blue, blue buttons grey, picked controls dimmed. Ten of the twelve audits from 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21 carry a note apologising for it. The pictures the user looks at should show the colours they would see.
notes: Evidence: grep -l 'behind another app' queue/audits/2026-10-2*.json lists 10 of 12; for example queue/audits/2026-10-20-calm-redline-settings-after-sc.png (the Agent row switch is grey) and the rough list of queue/audits/2026-10-20-ask-rows.json ('the switch shows grey instead of the accent colour'). Walks stay behind on purpose (CLAUDE.md, Walks run while the person works; queue/bin/focus-drill.sh), so the fix must not take the front or a key while the person is at the Mac. Options to measure, not assume: render the snapshot with the window drawn in its active look (an offscreen render of the window content), or retake only the audit pictures, not every walk picture, in the whole-set window when nobody is at the Mac.
acceptance: Before: crop the Agent row switch from an audit picture a walk takes today, and the same switch photographed with the window in front by hand; record the colour of each

A walk snapshot that ends up in an audit shows the accent colour on switches, blue buttons and picked controls, matching the in-front crop by eye and within a small measured colour difference on the switch
queue/bin/focus-drill.sh on the walks that make audit pictures still reads clean: the person at the Mac keeps their keys and their front window
Audit shot notes stop saying the window was behind another app, and the runner prompt stops telling runners to write that note

log.note: 2026-10-22 digest: still on every audit. All five audits written 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-22 (request queue, model bake-off, painting, nothing stored, scenes) carry the 'photographed with the window behind another app' note on their pictures, so the user judged a day of Ask work from grey buttons again.
